title: SITC of desktop computer, Multifunction printer, AutoCAD, Microsoft office and antivirus software at Deep Bhavan Kolkata.
summary: GeM bid for supply, installation, testing and commissioning of all-in-one desktops, a workstation, mono laser multifunction printers, Visio, AutoCAD and antivirus licences for the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships office at Deep Bhavan, Kolkata.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata

sites.name: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, D-372/2, Taratala Road, Kolkata-700088
sites.work: Supply and installation of ICT products (33 items)

scope.item: All in One Desktop (Intel Core i7-14700, 16 GB DDR5, 1 TB NVMe SSD, 22.87-24.8 inch IPS FHD, Win 11 Pro, 5-year warranty)

All in One Desktop - Fixed Computer Workstation (Intel Core Ultra 7 265, Q series chipset, 4 GB dedicated graphics, 32 GB DDR5 ECC, 1 TB M.2 SSD, 26.81-28.74 inch UHD IPS, redundant ~500 W PSU, 5-year warranty)
Mono LaserJet Multi-Function Printer (A4/Legal print-scan-copy, duplex, USB/Ethernet/Wi-Fi, 40-44 ppm, 3-year on-site warranty)
Microsoft Office Software - Visio LTSC Standard 2024, perpetual licence
AutoCAD / Desk Software, single user 3-year licence, enterprise edition
Antivirus Total Security, 3-year subscription, per device

money.performance_security: ePBG 5% for 62 months (Advisory bank SBI); DD in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata also accepted
money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR/BG or surety bond; MSE bidders seeking exemption to submit bid security declaration (Annexure-III). MII purchase preference 20% (Class 1/2 local suppliers only); MSE purchase preference L1+15% for 25%. No MSE/startup relaxation in experience and turnover. Total value wise evaluation; no reverse auction.

period.warranty: Desktops and workstation minimum 5 years; MFP 3 years on-site; ATC: not less than 3 years in any circumstance

eligibility: GeM: minimum average annual turnover of bidder Rs 6 lakh and OEM Rs 6 lakh (3 years); 3 years past experience; past performance 80% of bid quantity
OEM authorization certificate for desktop computer and MFP; imported products require OEM/authorised seller with registered office in India
Mandatory: EMD or bid security declaration, PAN, GST, non-blacklisting affidavit (2026), ITR for 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26, unconditional price bid undertaking, bid acceptance letter

Technical scoring: average annual turnover min 30% of estimated cost (16 marks, min 9.6), solvency certificate min 40% of estimated cost (4 marks), similar works in last 7 years 3x40%/2x50%/1x80% (30 marks, min 18), time over-run performance (20 marks, min 10), quality performance (30 marks, min 20); overall minimum 70
Functional service centre in consignee state (carry-in warranty) and dedicated/toll-free service number
specs: AIO desktop: Intel Core i7-14700, DDR5 16 GB (2 DIMM slots, expandable to 64 GB), 1024 GB NVMe SSD, integrated graphics, Wi-Fi 6 + BT 5.3, ~150 W, BIS IS 13252 (Part 1), RoHS, ISO 14001, ISO/IEC 27001, EPR registration

Workstation: Intel Core Ultra 7 265, Intel Q series, 1x 4 GB dedicated graphics, 32 GB DDR5 ECC (4 slots, up to 128 GB), 1024 GB M.2 SSD, 3840x2160 display, HDMI + DP, redundant PSU ~500 W, ISO/IEC 27001:2022
MFP: monochrome laser/LED, composite cartridge, auto duplex, 40-44 ppm (ISO/IEC 24734), 100000 prints warranty cap, BIS IS 13252 (Part 1)/IS/IEC 62368-1:2023
Microsoft Visio Standard 2024 perpetual, 5 years OEM support
AutoCAD general design enterprise edition, per-user 3-year licence (2D/3D, sheet metal, piping, collision detection)
Antivirus Total Security 3-year per-device subscription, Windows
notes: Scanned print of the 11-page GeM bid document followed by DLL Kolkata ATC dated 14.07.2026, Annexure-I technical specification/compliance sheet and Annexures II-V. ATC text copied from a battery tender: 'Similar works shall mean Supply and installation of batteries', 'MSME bidders in relevant category of battery', and warranty clause 'replace the battery'. Buyer e-mail and consignee officer name omitted (personal); HOD e-mail dte-kol@gov.in. ePBG duration 62 months as printed. Item heading says 'Microsoft Office Software' but specification is Visio LTSC Standard 2024.
